reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.contents: This app is so useful. I found it one day after no sleep and feeling I was the world’s worst mother. I’m not even new at this but it all felt new. I think I’d lost a lot of confidence. I could handle my toddler son, Ran, no problem but couldn’t remember when Becky’s next feed was due or how to swaddle her or what to do when she cried for no reason at all. And all those other things that really start to worry you when you’re exhausted and there’s no-one around to ask. Anyway, this is one, tired, anxious Mum who’s just had her work cut down by 90% by this app. it answers all my questions in one place, and the relief is bliss.

reviews.title: 100% Recommend!
reviews.contents:
I absolutely love the Bloomie baby app, the amounts of things it offers to mums is so helpful! Especially when the postpartum memory loss kicks in.

It doesn’t just offer the usual milk feed, sleep, and nappy tracking. It offers so much more, it offers your all of the above PLUS growth, memories, health, it even gives you different types of play to help you entertain and stimulate your little one for their age, and the type of play you’d like such as music/connection/movement.

It helps you keep track of the milestones your baby might be hitting for their ages! 

The one thing that really impressed me on the app what how you can keep up to date with their vaccinations! 

It has everything a parent would need in one handy little app! 
If you’re like me that likes to just track, or someone who loves to stick to a schedule this app can help you!

reviews.title: Amazing app
reviews.contents: This app is really fantastic. Outside of the tracking feeds, sleep and nappies I love all the ideas for play and also the informative articles that pop up, it really makes me feel seen and understood when I feel like I’m struggling with something. Really, really recommend

reviews.title: The app I needed
reviews.contents: My children are older now but I downloaded this app to help understand my niece. I can't believe how helpful it is. I wish I had something like this with mine. The support, the information, and the humour. At 3am, when you're unsure and exhausted, this is the app you need.

reviews.title: Great guidance
reviews.contents: This app is great for parents with new babies, especially if they are a little unsure about what to do and how to react to things that happen. It looks at developmental milestones gives feedback on coping mechanisms. Thoroughly recommend and I speak as  an Educational Psychologist

reviews.title: So much potential
reviews.contents: This app is great, I like the layout and it has potential to be a really good tracking app for your baby’s milestones and day-to-day activities however the app is incredibly laggy, so I’m glad I didn’t pay out for the full version!
